title: Emundi Naalo Yesayya – Ebinazar Sastry Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: Nee nithya premaku arhathe ledhu naalo
translation: O loving Father, what is in me?
I have no worthiness for Your eternal love.
Even when I forgot You,
You did not forget me;
even when I left You, You did not leave me.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why do You love me so much?
1. Every day I resisted
You and never knelt before You even for a moment.
Even when there was an opportunity,
I did not pray; though the Spirit warned me, I did not listen.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why is there such great love for me?
2. Many times I have fallen
and forgotten a father’s love.
Though I heard the Word,
I did not change;
I turned my devotion into a mere act.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why is there so much love for me?

credits.Produced: Bible Fellowship of India – Zion Apostolic Church

tags: Bible Fellowship of India – Zion Apostolic Church
intro: Emundi Naalo Yesayya is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Ebinazar Sastry, sung by John Moses, Simon Davis and music composed by Elshadai Studios, produced by Bible Fellowship of India – Zion Apostolic Church. This song was released on February 12, 2026, through SEEYONU PRATHIDWANI YouTube Channel.
